Anthropic tool definitions for tool-use heal LLM (spec 60.2). Five tools: query_dom, dispatch_event, wait_for, take_snapshot, read_attribute. Plugin's llm-healer-v60.ts passes the `tools[]` array directly to the SDK. Per-cycle budget: 30 tool calls / 60s wall / 2 MB combined result body.
